steps.en: Install the framework package plus the collection adapter
steps.zh: 安装框架包和集合适配包

steps.en: Declare a collection: where it loads from, its primary key, handlers that write mutations back
steps.zh: 声明一个集合：数据从哪拉、主键是什么、写操作怎么发回服务端

steps.en: Materializes the collection and loads the data through TanStack Query into a normalized in-memory store
steps.zh: 把集合实例化，经 TanStack Query 把数据拉进内存里的规范化存储

steps.en: In the component, ask for the data a live query should return
steps.zh: 在组件里用活查询声明要什么数据

steps.en: Recomputes only the changed rows via differential dataflow and re-renders subscribed components
steps.zh: 用差分数据流只重算变化的行，让订阅的组件重新渲染

steps.en: Write by mutating a draft of the row
steps.zh: 通过改一行数据的草稿来写

steps.en: Applies the change optimistically, persists it through onUpdate, rolls back if that fails
steps.zh: 先乐观地生效，再经 onUpdate 落库，失败则自动回滚

value.en: No hand-patching caches after a write and no filter/memo re-render cascades; every screen stays coherent with the data
value.zh: 写完不用手补缓存，也不用层层 filter／memo 重算；各处页面始终和数据保持一致
